entries.title: The Badlands
body: An arid, desolate waste in Khaz Modan between Loch Modan and the Searing Gorge, cracked flats walled in by mountains, with a great canyon in the east. Only the hardiest creatures survive here: coyotes, cougars and buzzards. The black dragonflight nests in the ravines, and the Dustbelcher ogres keep camps across the waste.

Sandstorms sweep the region and erase the landmarks; a traveller needs a good map, plenty of water, and is wise to journey by night. Dwarven prospectors and the Explorers' League dig here for the secrets of the titans, and the Dark Iron dwarves dig against them.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg: Badlands (introduction, Geography, World of Warcraft)

entries.title: Kargath
body: The only Horde outpost in Khaz Modan, named for Kargath Bladefist, chieftain of the Shattered Hand clan. Its flight path ties the Horde's northern lands of Hammerfall and the Undercity to Grom'gol, Booty Bay and Stonard in the south.

Thrall himself sent the Kargath Expeditionary Force here. Its real target is Rend Blackhand, warchief of the Dark Horde, at Blackrock Mountain, and it is fighting for a road through the Searing Gorge to reach him.

entries.title: Hammertoe's Digsite
body: A dwarven dig in the northern Badlands, abandoned by Hammertoe Grez's team and taken over by a gang of Dark Iron dwarves, presumably part of the force that has moved into Uldaman.

entries.title: Uldaman and the Maker's Terrace
body: An ancient titan vault buried deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, where the dwarves of Ironforge dug before the Third War. The great excavation at its entrance, the Maker's Terrace, is now patrolled by Dark Iron dwarves, and troggs swarm the halls below.

Legends say the titans first made the troggs from stone, judged them a failure and locked them away, and then tried again, and made the dwarves. The secret of that making is said to be recorded on the Discs of Norgannon at the bottom of the vault.

entries.title: Angor Fortress
body: The main base of the Dark Iron dwarves in the Badlands, from which they organise their plundering of Uldaman. An agent of Ragnaros, Ambassador Infernus, resides in the keep.

entries.title: Lethlor Ravine
body: A wide, craggy valley in the eastern Badlands, home to whelps and drakes of the black dragonflight. Strange crystal obelisks stand among the rocks.

entries.title: The Ogre Camps
body: The Dustbelcher ogres make their home in the great mound of Dustbelch Grotto in the south-west and in four camps across the waste, Boff, Cagg, Kosh and Wurg. Their leader, Boss Tho'grun, travels between them. From Camp Kosh in the north they prey on the supply caravans that must cross the Badlands to Kargath and the Searing Gorge.

entries.title: Agmond's End
body: An abandoned dig in the south of the Badlands, where the dwarven prospector Agmond met an unfortunate end at the hands of the troggs who infest it.

entries.title: Lotwil's Camp
body: A small camp just east of Kargath, where the gnome Lotwil Veriatus, a scholar of some renown in the elemental sciences, works on his latest project, with his sarcastic assistant Lucien Tosselwrench and his robot guardian Servo.

entries.title: Apocryphan's Rest
body: The skeleton of a great dragon, fallen in the waste south of Kargath, now picked over by a flock of hungry buzzards.

entries.title: The Dustbowl and the Valley of Fangs
body: The open heart of the Badlands. In the Dustbowl coyotes, buzzards and rock elementals roam among cacti and a few hardy trees. The Valley of Fangs, between two massive stone formations, is home to wolves and cougars, and a small camp of travellers. To the west, the Mirage Flats belong to buzzards and coyotes.

entries.title: Hammertoe Grez
body: A dwarven prospector who led the dig at Hammertoe's Digsite, until the Dark Irons drove his team out.

entries.title: Theldurin the Lost
body: A dwarf who was once a member of the Twilight's Hammer, until he lost his mind and scorned their teachings. Before he fled, he stole the Scroll of Myzrael, to keep the cult from freeing the mad elemental imprisoned beneath the Arathi Highlands. The cult never caught him; he hides in the Badlands, gibbering of an "approaching doom" beneath the surface.
The scroll did not stay his. Enraged earth elementals took it from him, tore it up, and fight over the pieces.

entries.title: Lotwil Veriatus
body: A gnome born in Kharanos who dreams of founding a university for the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences. He is brilliant, absent-minded and wholly absorbed in his work; he likes to combine everything. His latest project, shackles of elemental binding, joins engineering, alchemy and the arcane, and so far has mostly summoned very large elementals.

entries.title: The Shadowforge and Uldaman
body: The Dark Iron dwarves of the Shadowforge have come out of Blackrock Mountain into the Badlands in force, driving the Ironforge prospectors from their digs and seizing Uldaman for themselves. With them comes an envoy of their master, the Firelord Ragnaros. Whatever the titans left buried in the vault, the Dark Irons mean to have it first.

entries.title: The Second War in the Badlands
body: During the Second War, warriors of the Black Tooth Grin escorted Cho'gall of the Twilight's Hammer across the Badlands to inspect the Horde's oil refineries near Grim Batol. A Stromgarde task force was in the area, deep in occupied Khaz Modan, and the orcs killed them.
